claims.location: ## Read the private-land rules and training boundaries paragraph 1
claims.claim: [The published Kotakuji preservation-group rules](http://mt-farm.info/koutakujiaizen.html) explain that the crag is private land. They require rubbish removal, no tree cutting, no fires and no tents at the crag or parking. The page records a 2016 agreement and says detailed restrictions on crampons and ice tools have been posted at the base since 2019. This does not establish that older route-based boundaries are the current complete permission.
